post.title: Your CAD seat ends when school does. BrokenLiquid is free.
post.caption: One fresh grudge: parametric 3D CAD for Windows, for everyone who lost the seat when they left school or work and won't rent it back.

segments.quote: The professional tools cost a lot, many of them now need an online account just to start
